FAILURE_MODE: stale evidence remains active
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: v2 evaluates whatever records the host supplies for the tick; no age check in v2 core
EFFECT: a function or verdict rests on evidence older than its meaning
CURRENT_MITIGATION: v1.1 MaxAge stale timeouts on the v1 path; timing domain three timestamps
MISSING_MITIGATION: per-record max age from a contract; STALE admissibility status

FAILURE_MODE: evidence generated under configuration C0 used after transition to C1
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: records carry no configuration or context epoch
EFFECT: evidence semantics silently change (XSYS-001 compensation case)
CURRENT_MITIGATION: none in core; XSYS-001 pipeline imposed windows externally
MISSING_MITIGATION: context epoch on each record; invalidation on transition

FAILURE_MODE: two monitors disagree because their assumptions differ
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: no declared assumptions; disagreement not represented
EFFECT: one monitor's refutation silently wins
MISSING_MITIGATION: contracts; disagreement record naming differing validity regions

FAILURE_MODE: a monitor assumption becomes false
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: assumptions undeclared
EFFECT: producer output keeps being used outside its validity
MISSING_MITIGATION: enable conditions and valid-while conditions checked each evaluation

FAILURE_MODE: duplicate evidence treated as independent
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: no evidence identity; attribution counts any nominal record
EFFECT: false exclusion or false confirmation
CURRENT_MITIGATION: localization set elimination is idempotent, so counts do not matter there
MISSING_MITIGATION: evidence_id; derived_from; dependency tags

FAILURE_MODE: correlated evidence causes false confidence
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: shared-source records can confirm and refute together
EFFECT: a single corrupted source eliminates the true hypothesis
CURRENT_MITIGATION: declared dependencies used only for common-cause naming
MISSING_MITIGATION: dependency tags; refutation requires independence from the suspected component

FAILURE_MODE: one detector dominates because its output scale differs
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: v2 is categorical (no fused numbers)
EFFECT: none in v2 today; would appear if numeric fusion were added
CURRENT_MITIGATION: categorical records; no score anywhere in v2 (by design)
MISSING_MITIGATION: keep: forbid cross-producer numeric fusion

FAILURE_MODE: a detector reports outside its validated operating region
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: no operating-region declaration per producer
EFFECT: unvalidated output treated as validated
CURRENT_MITIGATION: Trust Contract v0.1 has a validity domain but is not wired into v2
MISSING_MITIGATION: contract operating regime checked against context

FAILURE_MODE: a missing sensor silently removes diagnosability
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: unmeasurable predicates reported per localization but not summarised as lost discrimination
EFFECT: an operator does not learn that a hypothesis became undecidable
CURRENT_MITIGATION: UNAVAILABLE is never NOMINAL; unmeasurable list in each localization
MISSING_MITIGATION: information-need output naming the blocked discriminators

FAILURE_MODE: an estimator reset invalidates historical residual evidence
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: no reset awareness in v2; PX4 and ArduPilot publish reset counters and deltas
EFFECT: accumulated statistics span a discontinuity
CURRENT_MITIGATION: none in CSIA; fielded autopilots reset their own comparison statistics
MISSING_MITIGATION: estimator reset counters in context; invalidate dependent accumulations

FAILURE_MODE: controller reconfiguration changes physical evidence semantics
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: no controller-mode context
EFFECT: exonerating reads after compensation (55/55 wrong in the negative control)
CURRENT_MITIGATION: time windows applied in research only
MISSING_MITIGATION: controller and allocation context; event-bounded validity

FAILURE_MODE: timing jitter invalidates a temporal relationship
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: records carry three timestamps, but no relative-consistency bound across jointly used records
EFFECT: a relation computed from misaligned samples
CURRENT_MITIGATION: timing domain; v1 sample-and-hold tolerates about 40 ms (FMEA v0.7 F9)
MISSING_MITIGATION: relative-consistency bound (maximum skew) in contracts

FAILURE_MODE: model mismatch produces unsupported attribution
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: all-refuted and unconfirmed-survivor both called UNSUPPORTED
EFFECT: a model-inadequacy signal reads like weak evidence
CURRENT_MITIGATION: UNSUPPORTED is at least not SUPPORTED
MISSING_MITIGATION: split verdicts (no consistent hypothesis vs insufficient evidence)

FAILURE_MODE: conflicting monitors averaged into apparent confidence
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: no averaging in v2; refutation wins silently instead
EFFECT: disagreement hidden rather than averaged
MISSING_MITIGATION: explicit disagreement record

FAILURE_MODE: a monitor fails or becomes stale
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: plugin-level supervision only; a predicate that raises becomes None
EFFECT: a broken check looks like an unmeasurable one
MISSING_MITIGATION: per-producer health with NOT_VALID output; predicate-error reason

FAILURE_MODE: evidence provenance is lost
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: free-form provenance dict; no evidence id
EFFECT: a decision cannot be traced to inputs after the fact
CURRENT_MITIGATION: ledger records events with dependencies and attribution
MISSING_MITIGATION: evidence_id, producer identity and version, derived_from, context epoch

FAILURE_MODE: runtime configuration differs from validation configuration
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: records carry no configuration version; config gate outside core
EFFECT: results claimed under a configuration nobody validated
CURRENT_MITIGATION: exact-key config gate (outside core); plugin configuration hash
MISSING_MITIGATION: configuration hash in context; contract validation status bound to configuration

FAILURE_MODE: a method is used because it exists, not because it adds value
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: no registry of validation status or measured contribution per producer
EFFECT: complexity without assurance value
CURRENT_MITIGATION: program reviews (INVENTION_GATE CLOSED; MX-016 duplicate tool)
MISSING_MITIGATION: registry with validation status; minimum-resolving-subset analysis offline

FAILURE_MODE: self-referential exoneration
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: evidence derived from a component can refute the hypothesis that the component failed
EFFECT: the faulty component clears itself
MISSING_MITIGATION: refuters must be independent of the hypothesis's suspected components (ATMS-style labels)

FAILURE_MODE: an irrelevant nominal record licenses a unique attribution
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: attribution UNIQUE accepts any NOMINAL record in another domain
EFFECT: false UNIQUE cause
MISSING_MITIGATION: discriminators must be declared relevant to a competing hypothesis

FAILURE_MODE: a predicate implementation error is reported as not measurable
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: exception caught and returned as None
EFFECT: a code defect widens ambiguity silently and is never repaired
MISSING_MITIGATION: PREDICATE_ERROR reason and producer health event

FAILURE_MODE: an overloaded verdict is misread downstream
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: one token, three meanings
EFFECT: wrong operator response (collect evidence vs fix the model)
MISSING_MITIGATION: distinct states with distinct recommended information needs

FAILURE_MODE: the alarm layer and the capability layer disagree
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: peripheral layers not connected
EFFECT: an alarm reaches nothing
MISSING_MITIGATION: one assurance state computed from one admissible evidence set

FAILURE_MODE: a hold or recovery machine is fed its own output
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: circular dependency between a state machine and its input
EFFECT: deadlock (capability never recovers)
MISSING_MITIGATION: rule: CSIA outputs never re-enter as evidence; dependency graph acyclicity check

FAILURE_MODE: a justification asserts properties it never checked
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: hard-coded freshness and applicability in the witness
EFFECT: false audit trail
MISSING_MITIGATION: trace fields populated only from admissibility results; test asserts they vary

FAILURE_MODE: a numerically negligible input licenses support
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: activity test w > 0 without tolerance
EFFECT: false SUPPORTED_UNIQUE
MISSING_MITIGATION: categorical activity from contracts, not raw weights

FAILURE_MODE: a declared capability is not implemented
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: a form declared in the contract language with no implementation
EFFECT: a contract passes validation but means nothing
MISSING_MITIGATION: every contract clause has an evaluator and a test; unknown clause = contract invalid

FAILURE_MODE: absence-of-alarm treated as affirmative nominal
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: a CUSUM or threshold monitor with low detection power reports NOMINAL
EFFECT: false exoneration
MISSING_MITIGATION: producer declares whether its NOMINAL may exonerate (exonerating flag with justification)

FAILURE_MODE: a runtime topology change is invisible
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: the published channel changes its physical source without saying so
EFFECT: independence assumed where none exists
MISSING_MITIGATION: source identity from the autopilot's selection messages where available; UNKNOWN otherwise

FAILURE_MODE: an invalidation storm from a flapping context
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: repeated transitions invalidate evidence continuously
EFFECT: permanent ambiguity or UNKNOWN
MISSING_MITIGATION: transition hysteresis and a context-unstable status (the autopilot uses a 5 s lane-switch hold-off)

FAILURE_MODE: the advisory layer is wired to actuation
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: opt-in MavlinkActuator in frozen v1
EFFECT: CSIA acts as a controller
CURRENT_MITIGATION: advisory by default; output firewall default-deny
MISSING_MITIGATION: architecture rule: no actuation path in the target architecture

FAILURE_MODE: replay diverges from live behaviour
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: freshness reconstructed differently in replay
EFFECT: post-flight analysis disagrees with what flew
MISSING_MITIGATION: record admissibility decisions in the ledger so replay reads them rather than recomputes them

FAILURE_MODE: invalidation removes adverse evidence and upgrades a function
MECHANISM_IN_CSIA: if invalidated adverse evidence simply disappears, remaining nominal evidence could make a function ELIGIBLE
EFFECT: a restriction lifts without new evidence
CURRENT_MITIGATION: UNKNOWN outranks INELIGIBLE in the function graph
MISSING_MITIGATION: monotone rule: invalidation may widen hypotheses or move a function to UNKNOWN, never to ELIGIBLE
